verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Hummingbird ingests alerts from monitoring systems with relevant data, groups them into cases, and keeps an audit trail of work done in the app. Nothing documents a view that shows what changed about a monitored customer when a new alert arrives, such as a diff against prior state or earlier alerts. Alert ingestion and audit trails are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can inspect what changed when a monitored customer produces a new alert
